name: Nicole Chen
source: Nicole Chen, more commonly known as Streaming-Chan, is a live stream girl who sells $99.99 premium membership to viewers. She has no qualms about streaming her life 24/7, including her sex life (but only to premium members) and for her every day is an adventure.
